description: Dependency update pull requests for nginx-static: GitHub Actions and the tools the workflows install, the k3s and the NGINX image of the page Try it locally, the documentation site's npm packages. The common chart dependency moves with the chart's releases. tests/ci/test.sh guards what the bot updates and what stays manual.

helm-values.description: The chart's own values file pins no image, and the files under examples/sites/ name images of a private registry: the one image the bot follows is the stand-in of the page Try it locally.

helmv3.description: The common chart dependency moves with the chart's releases.

customManagers.description: Tool versions of the workflows, an env *_VERSION under a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' line.
The k3s image the page Try it locally creates its k3d cluster with; try-locally.yml runs the page's command. Only releases: no rc tags, no tags of one architecture.

packageRules.description: Release tags of the pinned tools carry a v prefix, the pins do not.
A new digest under the same version means a release tag was moved: approve it on the dashboard after a look at the commit.
The Renovate that renovate-config.yml runs, once a month: Renovate releases most days.

prBodyNotes: The job `oras` fails until `ORAS_SHA256` in .github/actions/setup-oras/action.yml is the sum of `oras_{{{newVersion}}}_linux_amd64.tar.gz` in https://github.com/oras-project/oras/releases/download/v{{{newVersion}}}/oras_{{{newVersion}}}_checksums.txt.

packageRules.description: The k3d of the job try-locally.yml; its pull request runs that job.
prBodyNotes: For a new minor, tests/ci/test.sh fails until "Tested with k3d …" in examples/k3d/README.md names it.

packageRules.description: The k3s of the page Try it locally; its pull request runs the job try-locally.yml.
prBodyNotes: For a new minor, tests/ci/test.sh fails until "Tested with k3d … and k3s …" in examples/k3d/README.md names it.

packageRules.description: The stand-in image of the page Try it locally; its pull request runs the job try-locally.yml, which fails when the page's output changes with the image.
The documentation site's npm packages (site/), once a month; its pull requests build the site.
The override in site/package.json keeps VitePress 1 on a vite 6 that has the fixes. A new vite major comes with a VitePress release that asks for it, not on its own.
